name: 黃儀婷
objective:
(1) 建立互動式廣告之理論基礎與發展脈絡
(2) 理解社群媒體與網路社群中的互動機制與使用者行為
(3) 分析迷因、參與式文化與數位擴散現象
(4) 培養以研究為基礎的互動廣告分析與設計能力
By the end of the course, students will be able to:

(1) Understand the theoretical foundations and historical development of interactive advertising
(2) Analyze social media platforms and their interactive mechanisms
(3) Examine user behavior and participation in online communities
(4) Critically evaluate interactive advertising and digital marketing cases
(5) Integrate research insights into interactive advertising analysis and design thinking
schedule:

Week 2｜Development and Overview of Interactive Advertising
Week 3｜Interactivity and User Engagement
Week 4｜Social Media Platforms and Interactivity

Week 6｜Digital Storytelling in Interactive Advertising
Week 7｜Online Communities and User Behavior
Week 8｜Research Methods for Interactive Advertising Studies
Week 9｜Assignment 1 Presentation: Interactive Advertising Case Analysis
Week 10｜Introduction to Meme Culture
Week 11｜Meme Marketing and Brand Communication
Week 12｜Participatory Culture and User-Generated Content
Week 13｜Ethical Issues in Interactive Advertising
Week 14｜Emerging Trends in Interactive Advertising
Week 15｜Assignment 2 Presentation: Interactive Advertising Research Proposal
Week 16｜Integrating Research and Design Strategies
Week 17｜Assignment 3 Presentation: Final Project
Assignment 3｜Final integrative presentation
Week 18｜Course Review and Future Perspectives
